objective.definition: Cross entropy + expected joint location error + supervised connected-joint vector error; projected ground truth, no fixed lengths or angle templates.

meta.implementation: Original Movira CNN, softmax, projected-coordinate / bone-vector losses, backpropagation and Adam. Continued training from its own previously trained weights. No external hand weights or training framework.
meta.annotationMethod: HaGRIDv2 provider MediaPipe auto-labels; not human-verified joint truth
meta.roiCondition: Ground-truth hand boxes and wrist-to-middle-MCP orientation used in crop evaluation; not end-to-end full-body hand accuracy.
meta.definition: PCK10 = within 10% of square crop side, against provider auto-labels; not manual anatomical accuracy.

searchConfiguration.selectedOn: 80 development full photographs; model/threshold choice excluded test and user examples
searchConfiguration.objective: Development only: all-point PCK10 + .15 hand F1 - .25 raw matched joint error - .1 raw matched bone-vector error

meta.selection: Fine-tuned versus unchanged original weights compared with identical new decoding/consensus code; selected on development full photographs. Cropped validation confirms mean decoding. Repeated regression data, not an untouched benchmark.
